# Marks of other organisations

These files are used unchanged in the README's destination capsules, each beside a link to its own service. They are the property of their owners; no endorsement is implied.

| File | Source | Terms |
|:---|:---|:---|
| `huggingface-logo.svg` | `hf-logo.svg` from the Hugging Face brand assets, <https://huggingface.co/brand> (<https://huggingface.co/datasets/huggingface/brand-assets>) | Published by Hugging Face "to use in your projects"; Hugging Face's trademark |
| `octicons-book-16.svg`, `octicons-file-16.svg`, `octicons-issue-opened-16.svg`, `octicons-git-pull-request-16.svg` | GitHub Octicons, <https://github.com/primer/octicons> (`icons/`) | MIT licence, `octicons-LICENSE.txt`; drawn in the capsule's colour, as Octicons are meant to be |

The arXiv logo and arXiv's colours are not used: arXiv's brand guidelines (<https://info.arxiv.org/brand/brand-guidelines.html>) restrict its logos and colours, with its name and web addresses, to acknowledging use of arXiv's API or data, unless arXiv gives written permission. The Paper capsule carries the Octicons file icon in LoopTitan's own colour and names arXiv in plain text, as the service that hosts the paper.
